seoPage.title: Is EV Charging Impossible in Apartments? Myth vs Reality | EVSavari
seoPage.metaDescription: Is EV Charging Impossible in Apartments? Myth vs Reality — practical ownership guidance for Indian buyers.
seoPage.intro: The myth: apartments block EV ownership. The reality: society approvals and shared infrastructure take time — many owners use workplace or public backup while RWAs progress.

editorialSections.title: The myth
paragraphs: Frustrating RWA meetings are real — but ‘impossible’ ignores societies that have approved points and owners using mixed strategies.

editorialSections.title: Practical reality
bullets: Start RWA conversations before you buy — not after.
Shared basement points with metering reduce conflict.
Workplace charging can carry weekday km for some owners.

editorialSections.title: When to wait
paragraphs: If you have no parking, no society path, and no reliable public backup near your routine, an EV may feel harder than petrol today.

misconceptions.reality: It can work for some — others need patience with queues.

faq.question: Should I buy before RWA approval?
faq.answer: Risky — get clarity on the approval path first.

faq.question: Street parking?
faq.answer: Often the hardest — map public AC/DC near home.

faq.question: Extension cord from window?
faq.answer: Avoid unsafe shortcuts — see extension board guide.

faq.question: Compare?
faq.answer: Compare lower charging-stress models if public backup is your plan.
